# /handoff-feedback - answer a lane sent for test

Read `.claude/skills/swimlanes/HANDOFF.md` first. Your list, then your answer:

```bash
python3 Tools/Build/handoff.py list --person Andrew
```

```bash
python3 Tools/Build/handoff.py feedback <id or lane> good --note "<what you ran>"
```

```bash
python3 Tools/Build/handoff.py feedback <id or lane> back --note "<what failed, the steps, the build>"
```

Commit `Docs/Handoffs/` and push (`docs(handoff): <lane> tested`). `back` needs a note: it is the next person's brief.
